summary: Re-ran the backend regression suite (now 11 passing files) and all pre-existing browser checks by name first, then added artifacts for the v12 acceptance matrix: Xande per-frame scale (existing check re-verified), the three new local audio cues firing at their correct phases, per-gift effect captions on quick buttons + select, the red/green dispute bar identity, backend idempotency of POST/GET /api/live/results, and the ADMIN history showing a single de-duplicated row per session+round after sync. One pre-existing check (round-credits-shows-correct-winner-art-for-both-fighters) failed twice on rerun purely on timing for round 2's KO; config/queue cross-checks show the app itself is healthy (combat_mode=normal, allow_finisher=false as expected, queue empty) matching the same shared-demo-backend contention pattern already documented in iteration_10 -> classified as environmental flakiness, not a product bug.

action_items.detail: round-credits-shows-correct-winner-art-for-both-fighters failed on both attempts this iteration waiting (60s then 90s) for round 2's KO/cutscene after driving lula to 1 HP via admin-damage-lula-button. GET /api/live/config confirmed combat_mode=normal, allow_finisher=false, fight_duration_sec=180 (correct/expected state) and GET /api/live/queue was empty both times, ruling out a stuck-queue or config-regression app bug. The first half of the same check (lula wins round 1) passed both times, isolating the slowdown to round 2 specifically, consistent with this check's own in-script note about unrelated concurrent demo_viewer/tscheck_user gift traffic on the shared 'main-arena' backend (confirmed present in /api/live/events during this run) delaying AI auto-combat from landing the final hit. Re-run this check in isolation (no other agent/session hitting the shared demo backend) to confirm it is purely contention. Criterion 7 (victory cutscene correctness in general) remains independently covered and passing via round-credits-covers-vertical-composition-and-auto-dismisses, round-credits-lists-multiple-gifters-in-order, round-credits-draw-and-empty-state and round-credits-contributors-reset-next-round.

checks.criterion: Toda vitória e derrota de rodada é persistida sem limitar o loop
checks.name: test_tscheck_round_results_idempotent.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/live/results with (game_id=main-arena, session_id=tscheck-results-<uuid>, round=1) -> 200, stores winner=lula/gifts_count=2. Repeating the SAME game_id+session_id+round with a different body (winner=flavio, gifts_count=99) -> 200 but returns the ORIGINAL row (same id, winner still lula, gifts_count still 2), proving idempotency. GET /api/live/results lists exactly one row for that id. POSTing round=2 for the same session -> 200 with a new distinct id, proving the round loop is not limited.
